children: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA, OCTOBER 20, 2026 – TheNewswire - HI-VIEW RESOURCES INC. (“Hi-View” or the “Company”) (CSE: GXLD; OTCQB: GXLDF; FSE: B630) is pleased to announce that its Toodoggone land package, totalling >30,635 hectares, is now 100% owned. The Company has made all the final payments on all its optioned properties, with no further payments outstanding on any property within the package.

R. Nick Horsley, CEO of Hi-View, commented, "We are now in full control of over 30,000 hectares of highly prospective ground in the Toodoggone District. Once all of our assays and data are interpreted, I believe we will have some of the highest-quality porphyry targets in the camp. It has long been our belief that the Toodoggone region will eventually be recognized as one of the richest mineral belts in North America, and Hi-View will directly benefit from its aggressive acquisition strategy and grassroots exploration to date."
Click Image To View Full Size

During the 2026 work program, Hi-View completed 63.78 line-km of induced polarization (IP) surveying, a 250 km² MobileMT survey, 3,251 soil samples, 337 rock samples and approximately 12 km² of geological mapping across ten target areas. Borealis and Lawyers received the largest share of work, with 41.54 line-km of IP and 2,346 soil samples combined. The program was designed to define priority targets and generate new targets for follow-up exploration. Samples have been submitted to ALS Global Laboratory in Vancouver, an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited facility. Assay results will be integrated with the IP and mapping data to rank targets and will be reported once received, reviewed and verified.
As previously announced on August 27, 2025 (see news release here or available on SEDAR+), the Company has issued the final payment of $200,000 and 434,783 common shares to the vendor.

Hi-View Resources Inc. is a mineral exploration company listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange. The Company holds a 100% interest in more than 30,635 hectares in the Toodoggone region of northern British Columbia, with no further option payments outstanding on any property. The land package is prospective for gold, silver and copper. Borealis, Lawyers East and Black Pearl are the Company’s priority targets, each with existing anomalies. Additional properties include Golden Stranger, Saunders, Oxide Summit, Nub, Ursus, Garnet, Junkers and Harmon Peak. For more information, visit Hi-View’s website or review the Company’s filings on SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca).
